stage1_evidence_shown.label: BACKGROUND
stage1_evidence_shown.context: Sternal fractures in childhood are rare. The aim of the study was to investigate the accident mechanism, the detection of radiological and sonographical criteria and consideration of associated injuries.

stage1_evidence_shown.label: METHOD
stage1_evidence_shown.context: In the period from January 2010 to December 2012 all inpatients and outpatients with sternal fractures were recorded according to the documentation.

stage2_added_evidence.label: RESULTS
stage2_added_evidence.context: A total of 4 children aged 5-14 years with a sternal fracture were treated in 2 years, 2 children were hospitalized for pain management and 2 remained in outpatient care.
